title: Terminal and Colony
author: Dominic Sandoval
blurb: Jonah Crane, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
